marketing.metaDescription: Log your daily activities, organize them into categories, and discover creative ways to use Sketch your time to understand your time.
marketing.hero.title: A blank canvas of possibilities
marketing.hero.subtitle: You sketch the categories, values, and goals your way — no fixed template, so you can track exactly what matters to you.
marketing.whatIsIt.heading: What you can do
marketing.whatIsIt.activities.title: Get to know our tools
marketing.whatIsIt.activities.descriptio: Activities with automatically calculated duration, categories your way, and ready-made reports — everything you need to understand your time, in one place.
marketing.whatIsIt.categories.title: Build your own observation system
marketing.whatIsIt.categories.descriptio: Categories with whatever color, goal, and value you want — flexible enough to become the observation system that makes sense for you, not a one-size-fits-all model.
marketing.whatIsIt.reports.title: Generate reports
marketing.whatIsIt.reports.description: Days logged, total hours, and the distribution across categories — a simple report, by period, whenever you want.
marketing.benefits.heading: Why use it
marketing.benefits.clarity.title: Clarity about your time
marketing.benefits.clarity.description: Simple reports show days logged, total hours, and where they went — no manual number-crunching required.
marketing.benefits.simplicity.title: Quick, frictionless logging
marketing.benefits.simplicity.descriptio: Name, category, and time — duration is calculated for you. It takes seconds, not minutes.
marketing.benefits.flexibility.title: Your way, not ours
marketing.benefits.flexibility.descripti: Categories with the color, goal, and value you choose — the app adapts to what you want to track, not the other way around.
marketing.useCases.heading: Creative ways to use it
marketing.useCases.freelancer.title: Freelancing, billed per project
marketing.useCases.freelancer.descriptio: Create a category with value enabled and log how much each delivery or hour was worth — the default value already fills in the form for you.
marketing.useCases.student.title: Studying, organized by subject
marketing.useCases.student.description: One category per subject, each with a daily-minutes goal — easy to see if you actually studied what you needed today.
marketing.useCases.budget.title: Informal household budgeting
marketing.useCases.budget.description: Categories like "Groceries" or "Leisure" with a value logged per activity — it's not a finance app, but the value field works exactly for this.
marketing.useCases.exercise.title: Exercise routine
marketing.useCases.exercise.description: Set the "Gym" category's default duration to 1h — the end time is already suggested every time you log a workout.
marketing.useCases.habit.title: Habit or streak tracking
marketing.useCases.habit.description: Reading, an instrument, meditation: the days-logged count in the report becomes your consistency counter, with nothing beyond what the app already shows.
marketing.useCases.focus.title: Deep work vs. meetings
marketing.useCases.focus.description: Start an in-progress activity right from the home to time it in real time, and split deep work from meetings into different categories to compare later.

categories.setup.estudante.title: Student
categories.setup.estudante.description: Classes, study, assignments and reading — with a daily study goal.
categories.setup.estudante.usage: Log every class, study session or review as an activity in the matching category. Use "Assignments and Exams" to see how much time you spend on deliverables and tests — once it's graded, fill in the grade in the value field to track your performance over time. "Reading" is for extra material that isn't a class or direct review. The 2h daily goal on "Study and Review" works as a gauge: if the report shows less than that on most days, it's time to rework your routine.
categories.setup.concurseiro.title: Civil service exam prep
categories.setup.concurseiro.description: Theory, review, practice questions, essay writing and mock exams — split out to track your prep balance.
categories.setup.concurseiro.usage: The secret to good prep is knowing where your time is going: "Theory" for new material, "Review" to reinforce what you've already covered, "Questions" for exam-board-style practice (log the session's accuracy %), "Essay" when the exam requires it, and "Mock Exam" to test under pressure (log your score at the end). Pick the right category before logging each study session — after a few weeks, the report by category shows if you're over-studying theory and under-reviewing (or the other way around), and the values logged in "Questions"/"Mock Exam" show whether your performance is improving.
categories.setup.financasPessoais.title: Personal finance
categories.setup.financasPessoais.descri: Income, fixed bills, purchases and savings — each with a value logged.
categories.setup.financasPessoais.usage: Every time you receive or spend money, log it as an activity in the matching category and fill in the value — it takes seconds. "Income" and "Fixed Bills" show your monthly baseline, "Purchases and Leisure" captures the variable spending that usually slips out of control, and "Savings and Investments" shows whether you're actually setting anything aside. In the report by period, compare total income against the sum of the other three categories to see if there was anything left over that month.
categories.setup.academia.title: Gym
categories.setup.academia.description: Weight training, cardio, stretching and group classes — with a suggested default duration.
categories.setup.academia.usage: Log every workout in the right category as soon as you finish (or leave it in progress and finish later). The default durations already suggest an end time — just adjust if the workout ran shorter or longer. In "Weight Training", fill in the weight used in the value field to track your load progression; in "Cardio", the distance covered. Over time, the report by category shows whether your training is balanced or whether a type has dropped out of your routine, like cardio or stretching.
categories.setup.diarioPessoal.title: Personal journal
categories.setup.diarioPessoal.descripti: Reflection, gratitude, mood and planning — a space to log your day.
categories.setup.diarioPessoal.usage: At the end of the day, log an activity in whichever category makes sense — it doesn't have to be every day or all four at once. Use the activity's description field to write freely: what happened in "Daily Reflection", what was worth it in "Gratitude", how you felt in "Mood and Emotions" (the value field takes a 1-10 mood score, turning that into a number you can track), and what's next in "Goals and Planning". Over time, the days logged in the report become a simple way to see if you're keeping the habit.
